item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["c8b2137234c8c1a53c6c"],"operation":"Recognize an HTML block through _scan_html_block_start_7.","condition":"A raw 0xFF byte occurs inside a quoted HTML attribute.","capability":"The parser must pass the byte to _scan_html_block_start_7 and use its result to create the HTML block.","consequence":"The HTML block form is not recognized.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: HTML block recognition is a distinct target operation."},{"member_ids":["2735fadcf745aefab60e"],"operation":"Parse a URI autolink.","condition":"A malformed high byte occurs after the URI scheme.","capability":"cmark_parser_feed, S_parser_feed, and parse_inline must preserve and route the byte to the URI scanner.","consequence":"The URI autolink is not parsed.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: URI autolink parsing is distinct from HTML recognition."},{"member_ids":["8019cfc531ee6fc53699"],"operation":"Recognize an HTML tag.","condition":"A malformed high byte occurs inside a quoted attribute.","capability":"cmark_parser_feed, S_parser_feed, and parse_inline must preserve and route the byte to the HTML tag scanner.","consequence":"The HTML tag is not recognized.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: HTML tag recognition is distinct from HTML block recognition."}]}
